name: Corporate competence matrix (illustrative bands)
note: Invented bands for the demo; replaced with the organisation's real matrix in Discovery.

rules.annotation: Above EUR 1M: shareholder individual consent, only after Valde then Padome decisions
EUR 0.5-1M: Padome decision preceded by Valde decision
All material contracts: Valde decision preceded by internal alignment

amendment_rule: Evaluate against new_value (value + amendment_delta); if the band changes, the FULL new chain is required again.
